rationale: The inputs identify four uncovered wave-1 concerns—split-contract drift, refresh retained-state boundaries, reproducible benchmark evidence, and an evidence-controlled G1 gate. Existing 0.5.5 BGSTAB requirements are immutable regression baselines, so the work is additive and uses only depends_on/extends relations.

proposed_requirements.title: Split contract drift characterization
proposed_requirements.statement_outline: Capture runtime-, test-, and SRS-observed split transport behavior and mismatches as reproducible evidence without selecting restoration, replacement, or runtime activation.
deferred_oqs: Which downstream contract disposition, if any, should follow the completed drift evidence?

proposed_requirements.title: Refresh retained-state boundary characterization
proposed_requirements.statement_outline: Deterministically reproduce current viewport-only and legacy truncation behavior across valid, absent, and poisoned local cache; active and hidden views; Unicode and alternate-buffer cases; and the 24/1,000/10,000-row plus legacy 2MiB non-product test corpus.
deferred_oqs: What product retained-row range and aggregate memory budget should a later contract adopt?
What checkpoint chunk and in-flight budgets should a later contract adopt?

proposed_requirements.title: Benchmark modes and raw evidence contract
proposed_requirements.statement_outline: Define reproducible NO_RENDER, NO_ANALYZER, NO_NETWORK, and ONE_CLIENT_SLOW characterization modes with machine-readable execution manifests and raw samples, without establishing product SLOs or budgets.
deferred_oqs: What evidence sufficiency and repeatability tolerance should govern later product decisions?
Which measured values, if any, should later become product thresholds?

proposed_requirements.title: G1 evidence decision and activation gate
proposed_requirements.statement_outline: Require a linked decision record to select confirmed-bug-only or architectural migration from completed characterization and benchmark evidence; keep later waves inactive unless migration is selected and a separate stable authority contract is approved, and authorize no local fix, authority promotion, UI change, or legacy deletion by itself.
deferred_oqs: Who adjudicates evidence sufficiency for the G1 branch selection?
If confirmed-bug-only is selected, which single reproduced defect may receive separate local-fix authorization?
